id: title:adboio:make switch tools findable from exec search and instructions

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a fallback word-ranking step when a regex search returns no matches, potentially helping an MCP-connected agent recover from failed tool discovery.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F8.H1 demonstrates a substantive implementation change: adding a fallback word-ranking step when a regex search returns no matches and recording the fallback match count. This represents a bounded capability improvement for the agent's command discovery. The chunk P1.F9.H1 is a unit test and does not demonstrate implementation, so it is not scored. The tier is assigned
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the agent actually encountering regex-only failures and successfully recovering; this is not demonstrated by the implementation alone.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is performed here; scoring is done after this chunk is reviewed.

observations.behavior: Adds a fallback word-ranking step when a regex search returns no matches, and records the fallback match count.
observations.code_quote: const result = JSON.parse((await exec.handler(mockContext, { command: 'search project-update' })) as string)
observations.posthog_connection: This could help an MCP-connected agent recover from a failed regex-only search by falling back to word-based relevance, potentially reducing agent errors when the exact tool name is not known. The fallback behavior is demonstrated in P1.F3.H3 and P1.F3.H4, while P1.F8.H1 tests it.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a unit test file. While it adds test cases and assertions, no implementation or production behavior is demonstrated. No score can be assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new test case named 'the switch tools too' with a set of tools including 'switch-project', 'switch-organization', etc., and an assertion checking if the generated command reference includes the string 'call `switch-project` or `switch-organization`'.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks the InstructionsFormatter's command reference generation against a specific expected string, potentially related to switching environments, but this is a test assertion, not a change to the formatter's implementation.
